desc:
Nitro CR7 is a stylized football star: an athletic hero build, a red kit with gold trim and the number 7, and boots ready for the pitch. We built him to explore how a sports or arena character looks in a punchier, mobile-friendly style.

The kit's panels and trims are modeled into the shapes, so the silhouette stays readable at a distance, and the face is simplified just enough to read on a phone. He fits in just over 12K tris and a single 2K texture set, shown in Unreal Engine, with clean topology for rigging and fast animation.

Building a stylized sports or arena game? We can match this look, or take it wherever your project needs to go.
